title: Case Summary Render Data (段D)
description: Deterministic render contract for case-summary.template.html. The LLM emits ONLY this object (case_summary_data.json) — never hand-written HTML — then scripts/render_html_template.py fills the template. Every key here maps to a {{placeholder}}, a <!-- LOOP --> array, or an i18n scaffold string in the template. The renderer is zero-medical: counts, fields, and locale all come from this data.

i18n.description: Scaffold strings for the chosen profile.json.locale, copied from the template's i18n string-table for that locale (or generated for an unlisted locale). Keys must cover every {{i18n.<key>}} placeholder in the template.

fallbacks.description: Per-placeholder fallback text used by the renderer when a scalar key is null/empty/missing. Key = placeholder name (e.g. 'labs_period', 'ecog'); value = locale-appropriate '资料缺失' wording. '__default__' is the catch-all used when no per-key fallback exists. Drives the 'every section always renders something' guarantee for scalar fields.

__default__.description: Catch-all fallback, e.g. zh '资料缺失'.

one_line_condition.description: Header subtitle: <stage> <histology> · <driver> · <current status>. Clinical entities verbatim.

sex.description: Mapped via i18n.val_male / val_female; never raw M/F if locale wants words.

age.description: Precise age, verbatim (e.g. '63' / '63 岁', unit per locale) — clinical-trial matching needs the exact age. NEVER the birthdate/DOB; birthplace & occupation are also excluded.

height_weight_bmi.description: '165 cm / 68 kg / 25.0' — values/units verbatim, BMI computed.

ecog.description: ECOG value; append i18n.val_ecog_inferred when inferred.

case_summary_narrative.description: 3–5 sentence objective narrative generated by subagent from patient_summary + timeline. Output in locale; clinical entities verbatim; no new medical judgment; institutions coarsened.

labs_period.description: Date range shown next to the labs section heading.

caveats.description: 0..N data-provenance caveats surfaced as a footnote BESIDE the summary — the carrier for Step-3c source-priority adjudications ('(来源存在差异，已按X裁决)') and any faithfulness note. Locale-rendered scaffold text; clinical entities verbatim; NEVER inlined into a verbatim clinical-entity value (that would violate the no-translate/照抄 rule). Empty array → the footnote is hidden (RENDER_IF caveats).

caveat_text.description: e.g. '手术日期：来源存在差异，已按病理原件裁决'. Locale scaffold + verbatim clinical token.

lesions.description: 0..N lesion rows. Empty array → template renders the i18n.val_pending placeholder row (section never deleted).

lesion_site.description: Anatomic site (原发灶 / 肝转移 / 肺转移 / 淋巴结...).

molecular_rows.description: 0..N molecular dimension rows (驱动突变 / 免疫表型 / DDR 与其他 / 组织病理). Empty → placeholder row.

labs.description: 0..N lab items rendered into the 4-col grid. Empty → placeholder item.

lab_value.description: Measured value + unit + (× ULN / status note), verbatim numbers.

lab_class.description: CSS class by ULN multiple; '' = normal.

treatment_lines.description: 0..N treatment-history timeline items (line-ordered). Empty → placeholder item.

line_label.description: Clinical intent per locale (新辅助/术后辅助/围手术期/姑息治疗/维持治疗/根治/巩固), mapped from treatment_lines.json `intent`. NOT an auto ordinal — do NOT derive 一线/二线/三线 from the `line` integer (perioperative therapy is itself first-line, so ordinal labels are clinically inaccurate). Fallback to a neutral phase label (第 N 段治疗 / Phase N) ordered by started_at when intent is absent; verbatim-copy an explicit documented line wording if the record states one.

line_note.description: best_response + reason_for_change + imaging course; verbatim, no additions.

path_label.description: Label like '当前较可能的路径：' '桥接：' '备选试验路径：'.

path_content.description: Restates plan already in record; no new recommendation.
